paragraphs.text: Andrios , Roaming Explorer , is an artifact creature wizard from an unknown plane.

The character of Andrios was created by Wizards of the Coast for a celebration card as part of the 2021 Heroes of the Realm program. It appears to be a humanoid golem made of rocks with blue glowing energy in the cracks between them. It can scan objects with its face and project an image of them from its hand.
